name: NS2009 Touch Screen Controller
description: The `ns2009` touchscreen platform allows using the touch screen controllers based on the NS2009 chip with ESPHome. The [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) is required to be set up in your configuration for this touchscreen to work.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of this touchscreen, defaults to `0x48`.

config_entries.label: Calibration
config_entries.description: The NS2009 is a resistive controller, so each panel needs its own calibration. Set the raw values (`0` - `4095`) that match the edges of the screen: See [Calibration](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/#calibration) for how to find these values.

config_entries.label: X Max
config_entries.description: The raw value at the right (or bottom if `swap_xy` is set) edge.

config_entries.label: X Min
config_entries.description: The raw value at the left (or top if `swap_xy` is set) edge.

config_entries.label: Y Max
config_entries.description: The raw value at the bottom (or right if `swap_xy` is set) edge.

config_entries.label: Y Min
config_entries.description: The raw value at the top (or left if `swap_xy` is set) edge.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually set the ID of this touchscreen.

config_entries.label: Threshold
config_entries.description: The pressure it takes for a touch to register. Range: `0` - `255`, defaults to `40`.
